description: Lower-level code for internal flash memory operations including sector size calculation, erase, read, write, and lock/unlock functions.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a given flash sector based on its index.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Calculates the starting address of a flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Calculates the ending address of a flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determines the sector index at a given address.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erases flash memory over a specified address range.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Checks if a flash memory region is erased (all bits set to 1).

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compares flash memory content with a buffer.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into flash memory.
